fusions.name: Darting Shoal
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 darting jets of water from your fingers at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage up to 6 tiles away. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Slipstream Lunge
fusions.desc: Slips through to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that from full range, leaving it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slides Right Off
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to slip off and land on whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Wriggle Room
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
